text_block_list.text: —Hey.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is this... the facility where I used to—

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: Did I get this problem right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is this child... me...?

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: Is this right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Um... Well... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: I'll study hard. And—race hard too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? This time it's... for the kids' 
race...?

text_block_list.name: Kids' Race Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 1st place goes to Admire 
Groove-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text:
See? The races are amazing too. She 
practiced all by herself and became the 
fastest of all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right. After all, only you 
can make yourself stronger.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That's how I've gotten stronger all this 
time. I know that better than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm stronger when I run alone... I won't 
lose to any Umamusume who relies on 
someone else as a crutch.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text:
"Still in Love" is... surely growing 
stronger than "me"—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It is nothing. Just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—October, as the trees gradually turn red. 
Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final race of Still in Love's Triple 
Tiara showdown—the Shuka Sho begins.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list:
I think I did everything I could over the 
summer

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes... I suppose so.
choice_data_list:
It's the final crown. ...I wish you the 
best of luck.

It's the final crown. ...I wish you the 
best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It's time, so I will take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I quietly saw off Admire Groove as she 
left the waiting room for the final 
showdown."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—So. Do you really intend to drop out at 
the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping out into the hallway, that was 
the question Air Groove had waiting for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone who always looks out for Admire 
Groove, it's only natural for her to 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only we had a relationship built on 
true, heartfelt trust, the situation might 
have turned out differently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, because she refused to let anyone 
get close, I was unable to win her over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've done everything imaginable so she can 
at least run a race with no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I am well aware of that. What I'm 
saying is—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"‘Can you truly make peace with leaving it 
at that?!’ ...That's what I'm asking you!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know what Alv is brooding 
over. But right now, she's... in far too 
dangerous a state."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do you honestly think it's okay to just 
leave it like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...All the more reason to watch this race 
closely."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Look at Alvf after finishing her run, and 
think about what you yourself ought to do 
moving forward."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What will I be able to do from here on? 
Right now, I have no idea. That is 
precisely why—I cannot look away right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—*giggle*. Ufufufu, fufufu, fuhaha, 
HAHAHA!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I waited and endured the whole summer for 
this! Right now has to be... when it 
tastes the best, doesn't it...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Now... shall we begin? Fighting over the 
final Tiara...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Still-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Driven purely by "instinct"... she became 
this strong... All for the sake of... her 
"beloved"...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No matter who you're running for...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is no reason for me to lose to 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I... have to win...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take you down...! With my own 
strength...!! I... can fight on my 
own...!!!"
